title: Snevily's conjecture
exact_target: Pair two equal-sized subsets of an odd-order abelian group with distinct sums; also consider the source’s even-order extension excluding translated even cyclic subgroup tables. The odd-order assertion is proved by Arsovski, as recorded in the cited exposition. \href{https://arxiv.org/abs/1004.0253v2}{[S3]}
